initial_batch.reason: One streaming benchmark still called the retired raw-event release interface; replaced by typed pair transfer in the validated source commit.

static_review.manual_scope: Risk-directed critical paths; not a proof of every inventoried source line.
triaged_reports: Private pinned-host published-with-null-owner state is not admitted by construction/publication.
CRT return-value leak report retains ownership in cpp_int; its destructor releases the copied limbs. Boost template diagnostics did not establish a reachable project defect.
Dynamic test namespaces and immediately invoked closures account for noisy whole-tree Python findings.

linux_c17_execution.scope: Strict GCC13 C17 application and actual C++17 split/merge implementation linked and executed in Ubuntu24.04/WSL after shared arithmetic extraction.

linux_process_syntax.scope: GCC13/OpenMPI4.1.6 syntax with actual RCCL/rocSHMEM headers and HIP declarations; compile-only, no linked transport or Linux GPU execution.

isa.summary: Unbatched ordinary and finite RDNA3 WMMA symbols contain no reciprocal instructions. Batched symbol retains two reciprocals for batch-address division; no whole-object no-divide claim.
